title: Six-class secp256k1 rho at 125.831797: a parity-free distinguished test on the 125.834417 package

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold six-class negation-plus-GLV parallel rho algorithm in proof.md and upstream-proof.md stops on every run within 2^125.831797 target-group-operation equivalents under classical-group-work-v2 (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit). Under disclosed heuristic H1, correction-borrow premise C and 2-cycle premise P1, its recovery probability is at least 0.39000001. For each fresh trail of length L, C bounds expected dx, dy, u borrow counts by (1/2+2^-10)E[L], (1/2+2^-11)E[L], (1/2+2^-11)E[L]; P1 bounds expected caught 2-cycles by E[L]/(4R). Parameters: M=2^23 walks in one batch on one processor, R=2^26, kappa=1.00009, p0=0.39001172, h=0.0000116. Memory <2^72 bytes; preprocessing capped at 2^59 units and included; no advice. The direct base is the accepted c8a6819e (kappa=1.00009, CORR=PREM+813/2^23), on ccb89656, 7680a8ca, 671caf26, 59498c9a, b14e7c12 and 34a30cf5. The kernel change is DP'': a class is distinguished iff limb 1 of K+C0 is zero (C0=2^32+977, K the even one of y and p-y), a class property of rate 2^-64 given K0 under H1. One CMP y1,y1,ASR #63 screens either member for it, so pass1p loses its parity branch (36.5078125 instructions per walk, was 37.5078125) and compare rounds pay 4.5 per walk (was 3.5); an anchor round's meter surcharge is exactly its two ledger rows. certificate.py recomputes the step, the ledger and the claim exactly; experiment.py executes the changed kernels (evidence.md items 4 and 6). No prior acceptance, review outcome or score is a premise. This is an analytic heuristic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Check production identities, a time-limited toy pipeline, interpreter execution of the shipped kernels and exits against reference arithmetic, counts, ledger and census rules. This is not a production-scale attack; evidence.md describes limitations.
